summary: Insufficient evidence to confirm installer-side threat
details: Package eslint-angular-react@110.0.2 was scanned with no concrete behavioral or static signals indicating installer harm. The package name combines three well-known ecosystem terms (eslint, angular, react) in an unusual way and the version number (110.0.2) is atypically high for a niche package, which may warrant a human look at maintainer identity and intent. However, no exfiltration, install-time fetch-and-execute, silent-relay, credential distribution, dropper, or backdoor behavior was observed in this analysis. Routing to human review on the basis of name/version oddity alone; no block-grade evidence is present.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
